cause.summary: A diagram of the method; there is nothing to recompute.

items.label: Text: 751 arrays and 113 TFs

cause.summary: The SGD archive holds 677 distinct arrays of the paper's 751. Casagrande 2000, Rutherford 2001 and Diehn 2000 (5 arrays) are not there; SGD keeps 15 of Roberts 2000's 56 arrays, 138 of Gasch 2000's 156 (replicates averaged), 55 of Spellman's 60 and 52 of Gasch 2001's 53; Yun 2000 and Protchenko 2001 share one file. All 113 TFs of Lee et al. are there.

cause.summary: The text says Table 2 averages Hughes et al.'s mutant/wild-type log ratios, but its genome-wide means (0.52 to 0.83, SD 0.12 to 0.34) are not log ratios: the genome-wide mean of the log10 ratios is 0.00 (SD 0.05 to 0.17) and of their absolute values 0.03 to 0.11.
